layout.hephaestus_tools.paxel.descriptio: A pickaxe, shovel and axe in one tool. Breaks almost anything.
mastery.hephaestus_tools.pathfinder.desc: Faster on stone, logs and earth; later saves durability and rewards continuous use.
mastery.hephaestus_tools.trailblazer.des: Digs dirt, sand, gravel and clay in an area; at Lv30 sneak to dig a straight tunnel instead.
mastery.hephaestus_tools.frontier.desc: Balanced gathering bonus; later saves durability, gives light extra drops and rewards streaks.
